# Question 1

> Download `additional_samples.zip` from this module\'s resources
> (available at the upper right corner) and transfer the `.zip` file to
> this section\'s target. Unzip `additional_samples.zip` (password:
> `infected`) and use **IDA** to analyze `orange.exe`. Enter the
> registry key that it modifies for persistence as your answer. Answer
> format: `SOFTWARE\_\_\_\_`
:::

::: {.cell .markdown id="OsVOcbs_nIB2"}
**Answer**:

RDP to the machine.

Download the `additional_samples.zip` into the HTB box, and then CTRL+C
CTRL+V it into the windows machine we RDP\'d to.

Open `orange.exe` in **IDA**.
:::

::: {.cell .markdown id="nrY-7dlapUdL"}
The starting function calls a bunch of functions, but by going through
them 1 by 1 we can try to find the correct one.

This function builds the mutex name `sync-Z-mtx_133` character by
character and creates a mutex. This code is to prevent multiple

This is not the function one we are looking for.

## `sub_40A7A3`
:::

::: {.cell .markdown id="mhW7metptzby"}
![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

::: {.cell .markdown id="ZO15YyDnuI9M"}
This code is pretty interesting! It builds a file called `intrenat.exe`
and drops it in system directories. This is most likely for persistence
and establishing multiple footholds on the machine.
:::

::: {.cell .markdown id="6LorVeUCpTu3"}
## `sub_40A908`
:::

::: {.cell .markdown id="Rtbh5eY0u1G-"}
![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)
:::

::: {.cell .markdown id="VHMsiUgeu9g2"}
Finally, we have the function we were looking for.

This code establishes registry persistence by:

1.  Constructing the path
    `SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run` with string
    obfuscation

2.  Setting the value as `Gremlin`

3.  Opening `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE` with write permissions

-   If the program has permission, it will set the registry value

-   If it doesn\'t it will fail gracefully, by cleaning up and exiting

The answer we were looking for is
`SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`.
:::
